newsitem.title: UK: UK refers Littlewoods' planned Freemans buy to MMC.
newsitem.headline: UK refers Littlewoods' planned Freemans buy to MMC.

text.p: The UK department for trade and industry said on Monday it was referring the proposed acquisition by Littlewoods of Freemans to the Monopolies and Mergers Commission (MMC).

John Taylor, the minister for corporate and consumer affairs, said in a statement that the proposed acquisition raises competition concerns in relation to the market for agency mail order catalogues in the UK.
British retailer Sears Plc said in late March that it had revived talks with Littlwoods on selling its home shopping business Freemans.
The company said it would negotiate a renewed agreement under which Littlewoods would acquire Freemans on what it called "substantially" the same terms as those announced on January 13 this year.
In January, Littlwoods had agreed to buy Freemans for 395 million stg but the acquisition was referred to the MMC.
Littlewoods then withdrew when it emerged Sears was talking to other possible buyers.
